title: W4ME Station – a WASM-4 runtime for Java ME phones
summary: W4ME Station is a port of the WASM-4 fantasy console runtime to Java ME phones, enabling WebAssembly-based retro games to run on legacy feature phones. This creative project bridges modern WebAssembly technology with vintage mobile hardware, resurrecting old Java ME devices for gaming purposes.
problem_solved: Enables modern WebAssembly games to run on obsolete Java ME feature phones from the pre-smartphone era
why_valuable: Preserves legacy hardware by repurposing old Java ME phones as retro gaming devices, demonstrating technical cross-compatibility between different eras of mobile technology
